 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Many people grew up in the Cristiano Ronaldo vs. Lionel Messi era, and that era HAS COME TO AN END!
 The Argentine superstar had already retired from international football shortly after the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and now it was the Portuguese star's turn. 
 CR7 bids farewell to Portugal with a record of 146 goals in 234 appearances.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Those numbers earned him two records: the most appearances and the most goals in international football history. 
 So, everyone, who will you miss more?
